additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0404066-DC/Si-D/DE- [X6BhUH, okP4v5] Screen saver & RFID auth.  issue, dispenser out of order CRM:00796001291
additional_info.body:
Hi Rudolf Artes,
Kindly provide me with the receipt URL for the payment terminal (to scan the QR code on the help screen to navigate to the URL of the CCV receipt search page). Additionally, for the QR code, the OCPP authorization URL is required to authenticate.
The dispenser is showing an active error flag related to the self-test, which is an early warning of a possible malfunction in the Dispenser PLC cooling fans. Possible solutions:
Check the electrical wiring of the cooling circuit for tightness.
Check if the cooling air filters are clean and not blocked.
Perform preventive maintenance and check by rebooting the system multiple times.
If the self-test continues to fail, it could be an early sign that the cooling fan may fail later, and it is recommended to consider spare parts.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
